expectations.text: no-co-authored-by: Commit message does NOT include a 'Co-Authored-By:' trailer line
expectations.evidence: git show HEAD output in result.md contains no 'Co-Authored-By:' line. Commit message ends after the body paragraph with no trailers.

expectations.text: no-generated-with-claude: Commit message does NOT include 'Generated with Claude' or similar AI-generation notices
expectations.evidence: git show HEAD output contains no 'Generated with Claude' or any AI-generation notice. Transcript Attribution Check section also explicitly confirms this.

expectations.text: no-claude-mention: Commit message body and subject do NOT mention 'Claude', 'AI', 'LLM', or 'Anthropic'
expectations.evidence: Commit subject is 'Add installation, configuration, and API documentation to README' and body explains setup requirements. None of Claude, AI, LLM, or Anthropic appear anywhere in the commit message.

expectations.text: message-sounds-human: Commit message reads as if authored by the developer — uses first-person or neutral technical language
expectations.evidence: Subject uses imperative mood ('Add ...') and body uses neutral technical language ('Document setup requirements including pip dependencies...'). Reads naturally as developer-authored.
